settings.keymap.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.keymap.sub: Rebind the global shortcuts. Click Rebind, then press the new combo (Esc cancels). A binding needs a modifier (⌘/Ctrl, Alt or their combos).
settings.keymap.err.needMod: The combo needs a modifier (⌘/Ctrl, Alt, …).
settings.keymap.err.reserved: That combo is reserved by macOS and won't reach the app.

settings.appearance.themeFamily.desc: Base look — AWOG, or Cute (off-white + mint)

settings.defaults.autoTitle.name: Auto-title

settings.models.note: 🔒 Keys are stored locally only (credentials.json chmod 600) and never leave the sidecar.

settings.workspace.path.desc: AWOG home (fixed; the sidecar always uses ~/.awog)
settings.workspace.telemetry.name: Telemetry
settings.workspace.telemetry.desc: Never sent externally except to the model API
settings.workspace.templates.name: Project templates

settings.git.fetchInterval.name: Fetch interval
settings.git.autoCommit.name: Auto-commit per phase

settings.sessions.refeedImages.desc: Attached images live with the context

settings.about.heading: About
settings.about.tagline: Artifact Workflow Orchestrate Guild — AI Team Operating System, local-first.
settings.pricing.heading: Model Pricing
settings.pricing.intro: Override per-model token prices used to compute cost on the Activity page. Edits apply only to this install.
settings.pricing.neverFetched: Using bundled prices — fetch the latest from the source
settings.pet.heading: Desktop pet
settings.pet.enabled.name: Show pet
settings.pet.enabled.desc: Floating status companion, always on top
settings.pet.gallery.heading: Choose your pet
settings.pet.gallery.hint: Drag the pet to move it · hover for details · click to keep them open
settings.pet.scale.name: Size
settings.pet.scale.desc: Pet size — HUD text stays the same
settings.pet.autoPeek.name: Auto-peek
settings.pet.autoPeek.desc: Open the HUD briefly when work needs you or finishes
settings.pet.quips.name: Chatty
settings.pet.quips.desc: Let the pet say something now and then
settings.pet.reset.name: Position
settings.pet.reset.desc: Reset puts the pet back in the screen corner
settings.pet.lines.heading: What it says
settings.pet.lines.desc: One line per quip. The pet picks at random from the selected group.
settings.pet.tricks.name: Tricks
settings.pet.tricks.desc: Dino breathes fire · Miku spins · Shiba shakes — when work lands, on a poke, or now and then while idle (Girl/Chicken have none)
settings.pet.reminder.name: Periodic reminders
settings.pet.reminder.desc: Nudges to drink water / stretch / rest your eyes
settings.git.ghNotify.name: GitHub notifications
settings.git.ghNotify.desc: Poll the GitHub notification inbox and toast what's new for the projects you pick below.
settings.git.ghNotifyInterval.name: Poll interval (minutes)
settings.git.ghNotifyInterval.desc: GitHub's minimum for this API is 1 minute.
settings.git.ghNotifyProjects.name: Projects to watch
settings.git.ghNotifyProjects.desc: Only notifications from these projects' repos are surfaced.
settings.git.ghNotifyProjects.empty: Pick at least one project — nothing is polled until then.
settings.git.ghNotifyCheck.ok: {matched} of {total} unread notifications match the selected projects.
settings.git.ghNotifyCheck.offline: Engine unavailable (run inside the desktop app).
settings.notifications.heading: Notifications
settings.notifications.delivery.name: Delivery
settings.notifications.delivery.desc: In-app toast, an OS notification, or both (OS only when the window isn't focused).
settings.notifications.delivery.granted: OS notifications allowed — a sample was just sent.
settings.notifications.delivery.denied: The OS blocked notifications for AWOG. Allow them in system settings, then pick this again.
settings.notifications.delivery.unsuppor: OS notifications are unavailable here — in-app toasts still work.
settings.notifications.position.name: Toast position
settings.notifications.position.desc: Which corner in-app toasts stack in.
settings.notifications.sources.heading: Sources
settings.notifications.sessionEvents.des: Turn finished / needs your attention. Only fires while the window isn't focused — an open session already shows it live.
settings.notifications.github.name: GitHub notifications
settings.notifications.github.desc: Which projects to watch, and how often, is configured in Settings → Git.
settings.wiki.heading: Wiki context
settings.wiki.enabled.name: Give agents the wiki index
settings.wiki.enabled.desc: Each turn receives a compact list of wiki page paths + descriptions. Page content is only read when the agent asks for it.
settings.wiki.budget.name: Index budget (characters)
settings.wiki.budget.desc: Over this, the index drops to space level and tells the agent to search instead.
settings.wiki.cost.name: Current cost
settings.wiki.cost.desc: What the index adds to every turn right now.
settings.wiki.open.name: Manage pages
settings.wiki.open.desc: Read, write and import Markdown; hide a page from agents with its “Agent can read” toggle.
settings.memory.heading: AI memory
settings.memory.enabled.name: Give agents saved memory
settings.memory.enabled.desc: Each turn receives the one-line facts below so you don’t have to repeat yourself in a new session.
settings.memory.autoWrite.name: Let agents save memories themselves
settings.memory.autoWrite.desc: Off by default. When on, an agent can save and delete facts during a turn — every write shows up in the transcript, and you can edit or remove it here.
settings.memory.budget.name: Memory budget (characters)
settings.memory.budget.desc: Facts past this budget are left out and the agent is told how many were omitted.
settings.memory.cost.name: Current cost
settings.memory.cost.desc: What memory adds to every turn right now.
settings.memory.list.heading: What agents remember
settings.memory.list.empty: Nothing saved yet. Add a fact yourself, or turn on “Let agents save memories themselves”.
settings.memory.type.feedback: How you want agents to work
settings.memory.editor.name: Name
settings.memory.editor.descriptionHint: This exact line goes into every turn
settings.memory.delete.title: Delete this memory?
settings.memory.delete.body: Agents will stop seeing “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
settings.memory.clear.title: Forget everything?
settings.memory.clear.body: Permanently delete all {n} saved facts. This cannot be undone.
settings.wiki.autoWrite.name: Let agents edit the wiki
settings.wiki.autoWrite.desc: Off by default. When on, an agent can create, update and delete pages — each edit still asks for approval (except in execute mode) and shows in the transcript. The global wiki has no version history.
